scope.trace_sampling: first and last private learning browser trace per six formal run; not all traces/evaluation/browser storage

session_findings.inference: JWT-shaped local site cookie values are bearer-like authentication material; synthetic account identity does not make session values suitable for verbatim publication. Actual expiry/revocation/reusability was not tested.

paths: runtime public-fixture copies and derived learner scripts/logs containing those fixture literals
publication_classes.block_recommendation: not a real third-party account credential by fixture metadata; may retain explicitly labelled synthetic fixture under private publication policy, but never use this classification to exempt session tokens or external credentials

paths: any browser storage-state, network trace/HAR, login response-body or cookie/localStorage dump copied into evidence
publication_classes.block_recommendation: block verbatim token/cookie/session values; create separate sanitized export, recursively inspect ZIP/HAR/network records and embedded response resources; preserve immutable originals outside publication and record source/export SHA mapping

paths: any Authorization/API-key/access_token/refresh_token values in generic CLI/session logs
publication_classes.block_recommendation: exclude credential stores and raw secrets; do not open auth.json for this task; scanner owner must inspect authorized evidence exports without echoing values. No absence conclusion from this bounded domain review

export_guidance.immutable_originals: leave originals and frozen hashes unchanged
export_guidance.trace_transform: replace Cookie/Set-Cookie/Authorization values and browser cookies/localStorage/sessionStorage token values, plus login token response bodies wherever duplicated. Keep event timing/status/locator evidence and mark redactions; do not claim redacted bytes equal originals.
export_guidance.account_fixture_policy: keep ordinary account and public_fixture labels; if replacing synthetic account strings, consistently map copies without printing them; do not silently rewrite original hashes

limitations: Only 12 learning trace ZIPs were sampled; evaluation, pilot, private readiness, screenshots, response resources and all generic logs were not exhaustively classified here.
No real provider/third-party credential absence was established. Full export scanning and a separate publication gate remain required.
Cookie shape and loopback routing support local synthetic-site attribution, not a live-session invalidation proof.
review_process_note: An initial source search inadvertently echoed a local public-fixture literal line in a tool result; no real provider credential or auth.json was read. Subsequent extraction and this report emit only schema/categories/counts/hashes. No values are copied into this report.
